24.original: Investigate the trail of scattered grain east of Wright.

25.original: Investigate the trail of scattered grain west of the Chisel.

26.original: Confront the former Eulmoran soldier and defeat the bandits.

48.original: I'm sorry, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>...? Please tell me you're a warrior of some kind...

49.original: You see, there's a gang of bandits who've moved into the area. They used to be residents of Eulmore, but were exiled for stealing from free citizens.

50.original: Now they've taken to stealing from us instead. And anyone who tries to stand up to them gets a good beating for their trouble...

51.original: Folk say they're former soldiers, and seeing how those bastards fight, I'm inclined to believe them.

52.original: We're just farmers here! We need someone who can stand up to them─someone who knows their way around a weapon! Could you be that person for us...?

53.original: You'll teach them a lesson, then!? Oh, thank you!

54.original: We've already hatched a plan to track down their camp─poked a hole in a harvest sack and left it as bait. There's a trail of grain now, leading away from the village to the east, so you might want to start your search there.

55.original: Head out to the east and look for the trail of grain─it should lead you right to their camp.

56.original: The trail of grain continues to the east...

57.original: The trail of grain takes a sharp turn to the south...

58.original: Bah, we've got us a sneaky rat, boys! Better grab it by the tail afore it squeaks to its mates!

59.original: You...took care of them? I can hardly believe it!

60.original: We work long and hard for the food we harvest, and to have it all snatched away by those brutes...

61.original: You'd think with all that training and discipline they'd have an easy time adjusting to an honest life in the field. But I suppose some men are cruel by nature.

62.original: At least there are good people like you still around to renew my faith in the world. You have our thanks!
